name: GPU Vertex Shader Isosurface Extraction
definition: A technique to compute isosurfaces on GPUs by drawing a single quadrilateral for each tetrahedron and computing intersections in the vertex shader.
summary: GPU Vertex Shader Isosurface Extraction tessellates large unstructured tetrahedral grids by storing data in textures and using indirect indexing to avoid redundant geometry, enabling processing of millions of tetrahedra.
